WORKING NOTES

Try this: Add film grain for a period feel.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with blonde hair in two
high space buns wears small wire sunglasses and
a red velvet zip hoodie over a burgundy turtleneck.
A thin silver necklace sits at her throat, and a
patterned quilted bag rests on her shoulder. Her
expression is calm and direct. A blurred night street
with soft city lights behind her. Palette of crimson,
burgundy, and midnight blue. Nostalgic and moody,
in the style of a late-1990s film still.
